title: forex-centuries: Long-run exchange rate, gold, silver, interest rate, and commodity price data (1 CE–present)
description:
Historical monetary and economic data spanning twenty centuries (1 CE–present), compiled from 27 public sources with a reproducible build pipeline: exchange rates (236 countries, chain-linked across redenominations), gold, silver, interest rates, CPI, GDP per capita, commodity prices, real wages, sovereign debt, regime classifications and real effective exchange rates.

The MIT license covers the code. Each source's data keeps its own license and terms; see DATA_CARD.md in the archive and cite the underlying sources you use.
